title: Hanabi Hand Tracker
description: A frontend-only helper for tracking what you know about your own hand in an in-person game of Hanabi, following H-group conventions. It applies the positive and negative information from each clue across your hand, lets you cross off possibilities and mark cards as critical, chop-moved, or finessed, and includes a conventions cheat sheet. A Svelte fork of jparkhouse/hanabi-tracker.
